primary: READ EXACT Phase2B saved primary design matrices; all variables/columns/horizons unchanged
formal_statistic: sup of all-six-parameter Wald=p*Chow F; transparent RSS implementation; dependent-wild bootstrap calibration, not classical F critical values
formal_bootstrap: stable-coefficient null, fixed original X, HC2 adjusted centered residuals times Gaussian MA13 multipliers; Bartlett covariance lag12; reestimate stable and split equations at every candidate in every draw
break_decision: BH q<.05 across nine formal sup-Wald tests; raw and Holm retained; candidate argmax is not a detected break otherwise
parameter_tests: recursive-residual CUSUM initial60; Hansen full parameter/variance score stability; same null bootstrap; classical values auxiliary; family nine tests per method
hierarchy: period and cumulative h3,h6; all outcomes and component horizons on identical origin-window months; full paired horizon/outcome HAC12 influences; intervals pointwise; no pooling overlapping windows as independent tests
regime_partition: shock-origin dates, same saved horizon designs; responses may extend beyond origin boundary; do not interpret as clean exclusive outcome regimes
broad_period: prefer significant formal-break dates; fallback equal halves of common h12 primary origin calendar, both N>=60; no institutional names
mechanism: Link1 exact p3 noquantity design: rolling60 and halves65/65; Link2 baseline fixed saved LP: rolling60 all h0..12, fixed half split from h0 calendar; skip both half equations when either N<60
placebo: current outcome on original h0 regressors INCLUDING current oil plus futureoil leads1..3; HAC12; individual lead families of3 per outcome and joint family of3 outcomes
reverse: futureoil leads1..3 on current price change plus frozen h0 controls INCLUDING current oil; separate equations, family3 per price outcome
summary_rule: TIME_VARYING if corrected supW and corrected CUSUM/Hansen both reject at any horizon or clear rolling CI sign reversal; PARTIALLY_STABLE if single-method corrected rejection or recursive drift; STABLE only no formal rejection, no recursive drift, and rolling signs >=90% same with >50% intervals excluding zero at all summary horizons; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. These are evidence classifications, not proof of exact stability.
recursive_drift: last vs initial120 shock-coefficient contrast with shared-sample full HAC12 covariance; Holm family4 horizons per outcome
hierarchy_claim: report positive/negative/cross-zero paired CI fractions at h3,h6; do not infer full-history ordering from point signs
